constraints: BOF does not guarantee faster payment.
BOF is not presented as a factoring company.
BOF is not presented as directly paying drivers.
BOF does not claim every issue is automatically solved.
BOF organizes, checks, prepares, shows, supports, and flags settlement readiness.

scenes.title: Delivery Is Not the End
scenes.text: Delivery is not the end of the load.
scenes.message: The freight may be delivered, but the money process may still be incomplete.

scenes.title: Settlement Gaps
scenes.text: Delivered does not always mean settlement-ready.
scenes.message: Missing documents and unclear pay items can delay billing and create disputes.

scenes.title: BOF Settlement Readiness
scenes.text: BOF checks the load before money moves.
scenes.message: BOF organizes settlement readiness around the load.

scenes.title: Driver Pay and Deductions
scenes.text: Clear pay. Clear deductions. Fewer disputes.
scenes.message: Drivers and fleet owners can see how the settlement is calculated.

scenes.title: Billing and Factoring Packet
scenes.message: BOF helps prepare the documents needed to support billing and factoring.

scenes.title: Exception Control
scenes.text: Know what is ready. Know what is blocked.
scenes.message: The fleet can see which loads can move forward and which need attention.

scenes.title: Cash Flow Visibility
scenes.text: Protect cash flow after every load.
scenes.message: Settlement control means fewer delays, fewer disputes, cleaner records, and better visibility.

scenes.title: BOF Fleet Assessment
scenes.message: BOF helps fleets find where their settlement process may be leaking money.
